_doc: Profile raceframe (PORT-TOP-06, 2026-11-21): the race-frame closure of 0x004111c0 (MatchT01G source re/match/t01g/004111c0.c, whole symbol BYTE-IDENTICAL), called by the frame machine 0x00492d30 (Match/PortTop_00492d30.cpp) only under the sub-knob MASHED_OT_RACEFRAME (Match/PortTop_RaceFrameKnob.cpp; default off = the PORT-TOP-05 counting stand-in). Settings moved out of porttop_bind.py by BIND-PROFILE-DATA; plan.json / stop_reasons.tsv / cpp_unclean.txt come with orch/PORT-TOP-06.
_c_emit: PORT-TOP-06 was written before BIND-CUNCLEAN-AS-C: its cpp_unclean.txt rvas are named stops, not C units
_stop_reasons: rvas another row owns or another unmerged branch binds: planned binds of them become named stops with the reason; an existing exe body of them is still reused
_static_stop: a bind whose own function is `static` in its source has no linkable exe body: named stop with the line
_group_same_source: several binds from one source: one wrapper (the rva the file is named after, else the lowest non-static one) carries them all, the others reuse it (one exe body per rva, rva-lint DUP-IN-TARGET)
